#!/bin/bash

echo "🚀 Iniciando Sistema A2A v2-ui-ts..."

# Cores
GREEN='\033[0;32m'
BLUE='\033[0;34m'
YELLOW='\033[1;33m'
RED='\033[0;31m'
NC='\033[0m'

# Diretório base
BASE_DIR="/Users/agents/Desktop/claude-20x/v2-ui-ts"

echo -e "${BLUE}📦 Instalando dependências...${NC}"

# A2A-MCP Bridge
echo -e "${YELLOW}A2A-MCP Bridge:${NC}"
cd "$BASE_DIR/src/a2a-server"
if [ ! -d "node_modules" ]; then
    npm install
fi

# Backend
echo -e "${YELLOW}Backend:${NC}"
cd "$BASE_DIR/backend"
if [ ! -d "node_modules" ]; then
    pnpm install
fi

# Frontend
echo -e "${YELLOW}Frontend:${NC}"
cd "$BASE_DIR/frontend"
if [ ! -d "node_modules" ]; then
    pnpm install
fi

echo -e "${GREEN}✅ Dependências instaladas!${NC}"

# Iniciar serviços
echo -e "${BLUE}🔧 Iniciando serviços...${NC}"

# A2A-MCP Bridge (SPARC Alpha)
cd "$BASE_DIR/src/a2a-server"
echo -e "${YELLOW}Iniciando A2A-MCP Bridge na porta 3000...${NC}"
npm start &
BRIDGE_PID=$!

sleep 3

# Backend
cd "$BASE_DIR/backend"
echo -e "${YELLOW}Iniciando backend na porta 6666...${NC}"
pnpm dev &
BACKEND_PID=$!

sleep 3

# Frontend
cd "$BASE_DIR/frontend"
echo -e "${YELLOW}Iniciando frontend na porta 5555...${NC}"
pnpm dev &
FRONTEND_PID=$!

echo -e "${GREEN}✅ Serviços iniciados!${NC}"
echo ""
echo -e "${BLUE}URLs:${NC}"
echo "  🎨 Frontend:        http://localhost:5555"
echo "  🔧 Backend API:     http://localhost:6666"
echo "  🌉 A2A-MCP Bridge:  http://localhost:3000"
echo "  📚 API Docs:        http://localhost:6666/docs"
echo "  🩺 Health Check:    http://localhost:6666/health"
echo "  📊 Bridge Status:   http://localhost:3000/bridge/status"
echo ""

echo "  Bridge PID:   $BRIDGE_PID"
echo "  Backend PID:  $BACKEND_PID"
echo "  Frontend PID: $FRONTEND_PID"
echo ""
echo -e "${RED}Para parar os serviços, execute:${NC}"
echo "  kill $BRIDGE_PID $BACKEND_PID $FRONTEND_PID"
echo ""
echo -e "${GREEN}🎯 Sistema pronto! Acesse: http://localhost:5555${NC}"

# Manter script rodando
wait
